'''Lomas''' is Lord [[Baldhere]]'s scout in the armies of [[Kandor]]. 

== Appearance ==
He is shy and wears a foxhead crest on his helmet.

== Activities ==
He accompanies Lord [[Baldhere]] to the meeting of the Borderland rulers.
